what: MedGemma 1.5 4B (4-bit) asked to box lung opacities on RSNA test images; ground truth from stage_2_train_labels.csv
prompt: This is a chest X-ray for a research evaluation that contains a lung opacity. Give at least one box for the region most likely to be the opacity. Reply with JSON only: [{"label": "opacity", "box_2d": [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max]}] with coordinates normalized to 0-1000.
note: the box convention is [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] on a 0-1000 grid; the baseline is a fixed central box covering a quarter of the image
